rules.rule: Read assigned IE product quotation lines from the complete authorized, searched result set.
rules.initialization: No new tables or backfill. The projection selects current persisted assembly, assignment and admitted acceptance scope before total and paging.
rules.dateAndPermission: Read paths keep the original quote scope, active roles, assignments and business clock. A different row or an unrelated actor cannot access the selected entry.
rules.expectation: The signed IE sees 16 assigned rows over two pages despite unassigned rows sorting first. The selected resource and original quote/row IDs agree. Root has the original unassigned view. A non-IE and a nonmatching row fail authorization.

rules.rule: Use the original row command, version and idempotency key and preserve a confirmed quote across a failed re-read.
rules.initialization: Existing quotations, budget and control boundaries continue from the release base. Writes remain on the original scoped request and idempotent receipt path.
rules.dateAndPermission: Only the currently authorized IE row is editable in the center. UI pending/retry state neither upgrades authorization nor creates another business write.
rules.expectation: A lost receipt reuses the exact version, original body and key. The stored price increments one version, an interrupted re-read keeps the success receipt and retry recovers the saved price with only GET.

rules.rule: Open the original sourcing and rework actions and return to the same authorized page, search and row.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §8.1, §8.2 and I02/I03/I05; DXUI T02.
rules.initialization: Reuse current sourcing quotes and rework queue facts. Original source-module routes and readers retain their state machines and permissions.
rules.dateAndPermission: No deadlines, financial calculations or new vendor permissions. Sourcing records are selected before the count and page; ordinary IE history uses the original quote author. Return URLs are same-site and require normal authorization.
rules.expectation: Signed native tests submit the original outside quote once, reopen its saved price in history, and return to exact context. The rework link opens the exact original row, and the standard direct URL still opens that row without an IE link or mobile navigation. Existing contract tests keep both original forms in their order-centered transaction shell. Native product views fit 1165px and 390px.
